item_short_desc: Take flight with Rothco's Fighter Pilot Morale Patch.
description: Take flight with Rothco's Fighter Pilot Morale Patch. Our patch is a 3" round patch featuring 2 red stars and a grey shuttle, representing the fighter pilot and flight school. The Fighter Pilot Patch has a hook and loop back, making it the perfect addition to operator caps, airsoft gear, tactical jackets and more.
